text.offer: Pritchett says, "Smugglers used an old crossing under the city, until something moved into it. Lupoggs: great hunched brutes that tear a man apart. Nobody's come back from the crossing since. Kill six of them."
text.progress: Pritchett says, "The Ancient Smuggler's Crossing is reached through the deepest tunnels of the sewers. Go in a group."
text.complete: Pritchett says, "Six lupoggs? I'd not have believed it. Here, you've earned every coin."
